meta.notes: How the world starts, once: world.type void makes a World Type of empty sky called Example World Setup on the Create New World screen. When the first player joins, start places msm_examples:example_sky_island with its corner at 0 64 0, sets the world spawn on it and sends the player there. game_rules are set when the world first starts (no phantoms here). new_player gives each player four bread and a welcome, once, by an advancement on their first tick. It all lowers to plain data pack files under msm_games/.
